item: unlistable folders make the erase may be incomplete (row 333)
summary: Every walk of both erase paths records a folder it could not list; any one gives may be incomplete (panic report unlisted_folders, caveat x12, CLI, masked could-not-check log); the watcher says DB salt pages destroyed only when every folder was listed and every file overwritten; held clause amended to during the erase x12. Release line: A panic wipe or secure uninstall that cannot open a folder it was meant to erase now says the erase may be incomplete, instead of reporting the key material destroyed.
